title: Sughra madina lut gaya
body:
karbobala se khafela jis dam watan mein aagaya
poocha phuphi se waaqaya zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
soghra madina lut gaya . . . .
1. bibi mere dilbar nahi qasim nahi asghar nah
i hum shakl -e- paighambar nahi , zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
2. bibi qayamat thi bapa khajr se jab kata gala
karti thi main aaho buka , zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
3. aaya na saqqa -e- haram baazoo huwe uske qalam
layi hoo main mashk-o- alam , zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
4. wo shaam kaisi shaam thi ghurbat mein qaid-e-shaam
bibi sakina margayi , zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
5.bibi kata kaisa safar manzar tha yeh pesh -e- nazar
nok -e- sina bhai ka sar , zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
6. har simt hain gham ki fiza ab kya madine mein raha
abaad hain karbobala zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
7. karke fida baba pe jaa sab margaye piro jawa
lekin mera asghar kaha , zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
8. bhai ka gham akber ka gham qasim ka gham asghar ka gham
tazeest hain chadar gham , zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
9. kya kya sitam hum par huwe jab sham ke saye bade
chadar chine qaimain jale , zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
10. wo jaa nisar -e- shahedeen cheron pe jin ke the yaqee
sab so gaye zair -e- zameen , zainab ne yeh rokar
<<DIVIDER>>
11.roye farid ahle aza jis dam ye sughra se kaha
har zulm tha hum par rawa , zainab ne yeh rokar kaha
